history.p: After having finished his eighth and last symphony in 1871, Gade turned to the orchestral suite when he wanted to write symphonic music. "Sommertag auf dem Lande" was written during his summer stay at Fredensborg north of Copenhagen. In a letter to his friend Ferdinand Hiller in Cologne, he called it "not a symphony, not an overture and not a symphonic poem".

physDesc.physMedium: 13 bifolios. Written in ink. Paper: 8 staves in blue. Paginated 1-52. Heading on p. 1: "Sonntag auf dem Lande von Niels W. Gade op. 55 für Piano à 4 m. S. Jadasohn." Across p. 1 Gade has written in pencil: "ubrugeligt" (unusable).

annot.p: Although Gade described this arrangement as "unusable", it was nevertheless published in February 1881 by Breitkopf & Härtel
